major_cooldowns.name: Arcane Surge
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Open the burst window with Arcane Surge; it spends all your mana for a 35% spell damage buff and a massive mana refund, so never sit on it because holding it starves the rest of your rotation of mana.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of the Magi
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Touch of the Magi inside the Arcane Surge window (mid-air after an Arcane Barrage as Spellslinger, or late in Surge to cover Arcane Soul as Sunfury), then dump as much damage as possible into the target before the debuff detonates.

major_cooldowns.name: Evocation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use Evocation only when you are out of mana, have no procs to spend, and Arcane Surge is not coming up shortly, since Surge will refund your mana for free.

major_cooldowns.name: Presence of Mind
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use Presence of Mind to fire instant Arcane Blasts during heavy movement or to squeeze extra casts into a burst window; talent-gated, so zero casts is fine if you did not take it.

defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Press Ice Block to fully immune a lethal hit or to drop a dangerous debuff; it stuns you so use it only when you can afford to stop casting.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Activate Alter Time before a large incoming hit to rewind back to your starting health and position when it expires, or double-tap it as a short mobility blink.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: Use Greater Invisibility to wipe threat, drop targeted mechanics, and gain a 60% damage reduction for several seconds after the fade.

defensives.name: Mirror Image
defensives.usage_rule: Summon Mirror Image to reduce damage taken while the copies are active; talent-gated, so having zero casts is normal if you did not take it.

defensives.name: Prismatic Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Keep Prismatic Barrier up as a must-cast absorb shield; its cast time is only 0.5s now, so refresh it proactively before predictable magic damage.

rules.description: Open with Arcane Surge then Touch of the Magi
rules.action: Pop stat trinkets and potions, cast Arcane Surge, then cast Arcane Barrage and follow it with Touch of the Magi mid-air so Touch lands inside the Surge buff window.

rules.description: Touch of the Magi inside Arcane Surge
rules.action: Always line your first Touch of the Magi up with the Arcane Surge window so both cooldowns detonate together; only the off-Surge 45-second Touch is cast on its own.

rules.description: Never sit on Arcane Surge or Touch of the Magi
rules.action: Send Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi as close to on cooldown as possible; both are short cooldowns and holding them starves your mana and Arcane Salvo, cascading into lost damage.

rules.description: Spend Arcane Charges with Barrage to manage mana
rules.action: When mana runs low, cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges to throttle your spend and keep casting; running out of mana is fine, just Barrage and continue the priority.

rules.description: Dump Arcane Salvo with Barrage at max stacks
rules.action: Cast Arcane Barrage at max Arcane Salvo stacks (around 20-25 depending on build) with 4 Arcane Charges to convert stored Salvo into a hard-hitting, cleaving Barrage.

rules.description: Hold Salvo and Barrage for incoming Touch
rules.action: If Touch of the Magi or Arcane Surge will be ready within about 4 seconds, hold your big Arcane Barrage so the spend lands inside the cooldown window instead of just before it.

rules.description: Add Arcane Orb and Pulse on multiple targets
rules.action: On 3 or more targets, weave Arcane Orb after Barrage with Clearcasting and use Arcane Pulse to accelerate Arcane Salvo and Arcane Charge generation across the pack.
Refresh Prismatic Barrier whenever it falls off; the 0.5s cast costs almost no uptime and a dead mage deals zero damage.

source_summary: Arcane Mage is a cooldown-driven spec built around stacking Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi into a single burst window, then funneling mana and Arcane Salvo into hard-hitting Arcane Barrages. Because Surge refunds mana and both core cooldowns are short, the guiding principle is to never sit on them and to keep firing them as often as the fight allows. Between windows, manage mana by spending Arcane Charges with Barrage and hold big Salvo dumps for the next Touch or Surge.
